test_title: SSC CPO Tier-II Previous Year Paper (Held On: 8th November 2021)
subject: general
question: Which of the following about Rembrant greatly surprised Rajamony and also made him happy?

options.text: That Rembrandt, considered as the master, copied the Indian miniature paintings
That Rembrandt was a great Dutch artist
That Rembrandt had inspired the Indian miniature paintings
That Rembrandt collected Indian miniature paintings

solution:
The correct answer is** 'That Rembrandt collected Indian miniature paintings.'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Rajamony was surprised to learn that Rembrandt, an esteemed artist, collected Indian miniature paintings.
 
• He found it rare and unexpected, as Rembrandt was considered a master who typically created original works.
 
• This discovery made Rajamony happy, indicating his appreciation for the significance of Rembrandt's interest in Indian art.
 
• Rembrandt's collection of Indian miniature paintings reflects the high esteem in which Indian art was held in Europe during that time.
 
• *​ *Hence, the correct answer is Option 4. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 

 

 
• The word 'miniature' is* *used to describe something that is a very small copy of an object. ('Miniature' शब्द का प्रयोग किसी ऐसी चीज का वर्णन करने के लिए किया जाता है जो किसी वस्तु की बहुत छोटी प्रति होती है।).

 
 
• Example:* I bought some** miniature** furniture for my niece's doll's house.*
